newsitem.title: USA: Man commits suicide at Texas shooting range.
newsitem.headline: Man commits suicide at Texas shooting range.

text.p: A 78-year-old man killed himself at a shooting range after renting a gun and taking a lesson in how to use it, officials said on Friday.
The death, which took place on Thursday, was ruled a suicide by the Bexar County medical examiner.
Ira Steward shot himself in the head as soon as his instructor left him alone.
"We've been in business for over 30 years and nothing like this has ever happened," said Mike McDonald, manager of the range, called A Place To Shoot.
"This is just one of those isolated incidents," he said.
